markup: What changes takes place in us from birth till adulthood?
answermarkup:
i) At birth our weight is 2 to 3 kg. By the time we reach adulthood, it becomes 50 to 60 kg for men and 45 to 50 kg for women. 
ii) Our height also increases four to five times. 
iii) There is no strength in arms and legs during infancy, but by young age arms and legs become strong and can perform many actions. 
iv) The brain develops from birth till the age of 6. Later the structure of the brain becomes very complex. 
v) At the age of 12 to 14 many other major changes take place in the body. In order to become a father or a mother in the future, the body undergoes corresponding changes in the structure and function.
